content_sections.heading: About Shivaji University
content_sections.text: Shivaji University is a university in Kolhapur. This notice comes from its Registrar and covers temporary daily-wage staff for the university's office.

content_sections.heading: Shivaji University Junior Clerk and Peon Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates are covered by the Employees' Provident Fund scheme as per rules. rows.event: Walk-in interview: Daily Wage Junior Clerk

rows.information: Main Administrative Building, Shivaji University, Kolhapur

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview, and the university will use it to prepare a waiting list. Selected candidates will get appointment orders, as needed, only after the university's current waiting list for that post is exhausted.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are daily-wage and will be filled on a temporary basis for 11 months. Place of work is the Shivaji University office. These posts carry none of the benefits of permanent posts. Working on these posts gives no claim or right to any post in the university's regular service.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Shivaji University Junior Clerk and Peon Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Write an application addressed to the Registrar, Shivaji University, Kolhapur. Keep all necessary original documents and photocopies of your certificates with the application. Go to the venue on the date fixed for your post, at your own expense, and be present at 10:00 AM. Hand in your application before the 11:00 AM cut-off. Applications arriving later will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. Will I get a job immediately if I am selected in this walk-in?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Appointment orders will be issued as needed, and only after the current waiting list for that post runs out.

faq.question: Q2. On which day should a Junior Clerk candidate attend?
faq.answer: Junior Clerk candidates attend on 3 November 2026, the day before the Peon interviews.

faq.question: Q3. Can I reach the venue after 10:00 AM?
faq.answer: Candidates are told to be present at 10:00 AM. Applications are accepted only up to 11:00 AM, so anyone arriving after that will not be considered.

faq.question: Q4. Is typing required for the Junior Clerk post?
faq.answer: Yes. Along with a graduate qualification and computer knowledge, the post requires knowledge of government-recognised English and Marathi typing.

faq.question: Q5. Can a 7th pass candidate apply?
faq.answer: Yes, a 7th pass meets the qualification for the Daily Wage Peon post, which pays Rs. 500 per day plus EPF and ESI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for reserved category candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age for reserved category candidates is 43 years, five years above the open category limit.

faq.question: Q7. Will this job become permanent?
faq.answer: The notice gives no right to a regular post. Working here creates no claim on any post in the university's regular service.

faq.question: Q8. Who should the application be addressed to?
faq.answer: Address it to the Registrar, Shivaji University, Kolhapur, and bring it with your originals and photocopies of certificates.
